[NGST.4.3] Embedded targets that cannot do file I/O compile the artefact
straight into the binary. `dsc compile-project <dir>` writes, beside each
module's `.dsc`, a `<basename>_dsc.h` that defines two constants: `<SYM>_DSC`,
a `static const uint8_t` array holding the artefact's bytes, and
`<SYM>_DSC_LEN`, a `static const size_t` holding its length ([RCLI.1.4]).
`<SYM>` is the module's basename upper-cased, with every character outside
`A`–`Z` and `0`–`9` replaced by `_` (`heat.zone` → `HEAT_ZONE`). The integrator
passes the two to `ds_engine_load_dsc` as it would bytes read from a file.
